footer.builtWith: GameScore is a demonstration of statistically honest game ratings.

scoring.metaDescription: The public score is the recommendation percentage. Rankings use the Wilson lower bound so the amount of evidence matters.
scoring.title: A score that respects the evidence
scoring.lead: On GameScore the player recommendation is the signal. The percentage you read is not the same thing as ranking order.
scoring.publicTitle: What you see on a game
scoring.publicBody: The public score is the share of positive reviews. A game with 9 recommends out of 10 shows 90%. The label (Very positive, Mixed, Few reviews) also depends on how many people spoke up.
scoring.wilsonBody: Top rated ranks games by the Wilson lower bound of that proportion, at 95% confidence. Few reviews leave the rate unstable, so the system pulls the value down until there is real evidence. A unanimous launch does not jump ahead of a classic with thousands of votes.
scoring.rankingBody: Top Rated requires a minimum number of reviews (configurable; the default is 50). Trending, new releases and popular use other signals — recent growth, release date and volume.
scoring.labelsBody: Fewer than 10 reviews always read as “Few reviews”. “Overwhelmingly positive” needs at least 200 reviews and 95% positive. The rest follow stable bands, the same in Portuguese and English.
scoring.reviewsBody: Review order mixes usefulness (also Wilson), vote volume, author reputation and a little recency. No single term can dominate.

terms.metaDescription: Rules for using GameScore accounts, reviews and catalogue data.
terms.title: Terms of use
terms.lead: By creating an account you agree to use GameScore in good faith: one person, honest reviews, no harassment.

sections.title: The service
sections.body: GameScore publishes player recommendations and ranks games with a Wilson lower bound. Catalogue metadata may come from IGDB. The product is a demonstration and may change or stop without notice.

sections.title: Accounts
sections.body: You are responsible for the email and password you register. One review per game. Do not create extra accounts to move a score. We may suspend accounts that break these rules.

sections.title: Content
sections.body: Reviews you publish can be edited or deleted by you, and hidden by moderators. After you delete your account, reviews stay on the game in anonymised form so public scores remain stable.

sections.title: Acceptable use
sections.body: No spam, abuse, review bombing, scraping at scale, or attempts to break authentication, rate limits or other people's accounts.

privacy.metaDescription: What personal data GameScore stores and why.
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.lead: We store the minimum needed to run accounts, reviews and anti-spam. You can export or delete that data from Settings.

sections.title: What we collect
sections.body: Email, username, optional display name, bio and avatar URL, password hash (never the password), reviews, votes, reports, reputation events, and a hashed client IP used only to spot multi-account abuse.

sections.title: Why
sections.body: To authenticate you, publish reviews, calculate game scores, detect spam and review bombs, and let moderators act. We do not sell personal data and we do not run advertising trackers.

sections.title: Retention
sections.body: Deleting your account anonymises the profile (email and username are replaced), revokes sessions and tokens, and leaves published reviews attributed to “Deleted account”. Export is available until you delete the account.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You can access, export and erase your personal data from Settings. For a public launch this template must be reviewed under LGPD/GDPR with a named controller and contact.

cookies.metaDescription: Cookies and local storage used by GameScore.
cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.lead: GameScore only uses cookies that are needed to sign in and remember language. There is no advertising cookie.

sections.title: gs_refresh_token
sections.body: HttpOnly session cookie set by the API so you stay signed in. It is not readable by scripts. Cleared on logout. Required for authenticated features.

sections.title: NEXT_LOCALE
sections.body: Set by the site to remember Portuguese or English. Functional, not advertising.

sections.title: gs-theme and gs-cookie-consent
sections.body: Stored in this browser only (localStorage), not as cookies. Theme remembers dark or light. Consent remembers that you dismissed this notice.
